summary: Vibraphone: soft mallets, jazz, lofi, bossa
label: vibraphone
body: Sparse melodies and chord tones, let it ring.

Register: MIDI 53-89 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Vibraphone, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Vibraphone") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
